This file documents the agent_keys resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =agent_keys=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: F68A1812-F9B6-5E3A-BDD3-FF1CF89F1428

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
agent_keys list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.agent_keys.list=.

#+name: agent_keys-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle agent_keys-list.ores :exports none

#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 984DCE62-35FF-5468-BD22-9A08583820A8

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

It is addressed at =iam.v1.agent_keys.get=.
